ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white/cream) on the lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) concentrated in the central median region and trailing edge fringes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous low-intensity region radiating from the median notch. High-intensity lobes (left and right) contain distinct low-intensity linear streaks. Left lobe features a pattern of parallel vertical linear blobs; right lobe features non-parallel diagonal linear blobs and mottled focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; estimated interior angle of 48 degrees with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire boundary; right distal lobe exhibits extreme topographic irregularity and deep indentations compared to the more consistent serration of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve sweep on both lobes; the right lobe sweep is interrupted by significant structural irregularity at the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark punctate clusters on the white ventral surface of both lobes; dense dark clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of the flukes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of five parallel vertical rake marks on the mid-left lobe; multiple intersecting diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular tissue loss and ragged deformity on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent parallel rake mark scarring on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The vertical parallel rake marks on the left lobe form a highly distinctive ladder-like pattern.
